params.name: Hook
params.evidence: 'Four billion dollars' lands in 1.2 s, inside the 2 s window, on a sourced figure.

params.name: One idea
params.evidence: Every scene serves 'OneCoin had no coin; it paid people to sell trust'.

params.name: Structure and turn
params.evidence: One turn at s5; the s6 payoff now adds a new thought.

params.name: Fact discipline
params.evidence: s7 'a number in a private book' paraphrase sits uneasily with s3's 'existed nowhere'; s6 'friend' stretches 'recruiting others'.

params.name: Written for the ear
params.evidence: Every scene speaks at 2.3 to 2.55 words per second in short sentences.

params.name: On-screen text
params.evidence: s4 'SOLD BY A STAR' is generic; s7 'LAST SEEN: ATHENS' sits close to the narration.

params.name: Visual intent
params.evidence: Distinct, castable pictures; the founder is never drawn.

params.name: Voice
params.evidence: s6 opens on the stock phrase 'Here's the catch.'.

params.name: Length and pacing
params.evidence: 66.0 s on a 66 s target; re-hooks at 14, 23.5, 34.5, 45.5 and 55.5 s.

params.name: Ending
params.evidence: The close fits only this film but lands more quietly than the turn.
